narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Two even numbers always have highest common factor two.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Take eight and twelve. Both are even.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Their highest common factor is four, and four is bigger than two, so that slip is wrong.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, pick a new pair for each rule and test it.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A common factor must also divide the difference, so test that as well.

old_misconception.wrong_answer: two even numbers always have highest common factor two
old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says two even numbers always give two. Eight and twelve are both even, but their highest common factor is four, so the answer is only known to be even and at least two.
